Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a short matrix (SLA_Tiers_v3.pdf) and our Dedicated pricing workbook. High level answers inline, then a proposed bundle for your review.

- Uptime tiers: 99.9 / 99.95 / 99.99 supported. Credits scale by monthly committed spend and are listed in the attached matrix. For dedicated contracts we can also provide a service credit + operational runbook commitment for 99.95 and above.

- Response times: Standard SLA (included) is 1 hour response for Sev-1 during business hours (M-F 06:00–18:00 PT). Premium SLA includes 15min P1 acknowledgement and 30min P1 remediation window with 24/7 on-call escalation. For Sev-2 we guarantee 4 hours acknowledge, 8 hours remediation for premium.

- Escalation: Premium SLA adds a named escalation path into our on-call engineering rota, plus a monthly post-incident review and access to a dedicated technical account manager.

Proposed bundle (outline):
1) Base Dedicated: 99.9 uptime, standard support, no named on-call — baseline price in workbook.
2) Enterprise Premium: 99.95 uptime, 24/7 P1 coverage, named escalation, 2-hour incident bridge within premium hours.
3) Compliance+ (add-on): 99.99 uptime optional, enhanced runbooks, quarterly tabletop exercises, audit log retention 7 years.

Discounts: 5% for 12-month commit, 12% for 24-month commit, additional 3% for capacity commitments > $X/mo (TBD in workbook).

I've asked Marissa to confirm operational details for the Premium bundle (on-call handoffs / runbook acceptance). If this looks close, we can draft a term sheet and lock pricing for 30 days.

Thanks,

Hi Maya — quick operational notes from the support side to complement Karthik's outline.

- 24/7 Escalation: For the Premium bundle we nominate a primary on-call engineer plus an escalation manager. We provide a single rotation contact for P1s and a secondary contact for weekends.
- Incident bridge: P1 bridges are stood up within 30 minutes of acknowledgement (for premium), with a documented incident commander.
- RTO vs RPO: We don't offer an RPO for inference output; instead we commit to continuity via fallback model variants and cross-region failover (covered in Compliance+).
- Runbook acceptance: We require a joint runbook sign-off (customer + Redwood) prior to GA of Premium coverage — this is to ensure responsibilities and contact data are correct.

Operational ask: Maya, would FinTechX be able to share a short on-call roster and a preferred time window for the monthly operational sync? That will help sizing our named escalation coverage.
